description: Optional data-source plugins (ADR-018). licence_allowlist: SPDX ids a plugin may be fetched under. priority: the single ranking of building-height sources, first wins per building; a winner with height_m and no levels takes levels from the next source that has them. OSM height, OSM levels and the estimate rank below every entry here (docs/04-heights.md). evidence: the single ranking of ground-floor shop evidence (ADR-022), first source with evidence wins per building; osm is the OSM shop, amenity, office and craft POIs and a commercial building category. Ids not registered yet (overture) keep their slot for the plugin that will use them. CDLA-Permissive-2.0, Apache-2.0 and CC0-1.0 are the Overture place licences, checked per record (ADR-021).
